chunks.text: Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes is the official marine ecosystem ECOMAR-058 in the Magallanes ecoregion. SIMBIO/SBAP reports it as a marina continental ecosystem with a total surface of 5,867.005 square kilometres.

Official geoforms associated with ECOMAR-058 include the Strait of Magellan, Isla Capitan Aracena, Isla Santa Ines, Isla Dawson, Isla Clarence and Peninsula Brunswick. This is an ecological-spatial classification and does not by itself define administrative, legal or protected-area boundaries.
